# Catalog reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalog_doc.py. Do not edit; run it and commit the result. -->

107 rules, all four domains on, default settings. A rule decides what a path is, never whether it is removed: that takes your selection and the executor's checks (see `safety.md`). Rules are tried by descending priority and the first match wins; a detector can refine the match at scan time.

Columns: floor is the rule's minimum age in days, which no filter or "Include anyway" can lower. Filter is the age the rule pre-fills for its group. Age basis `last used` takes the later of the file's change time and Spotlight's last-used date. Rows are ordered junk, review, protected, then by priority.

## AI agents (`agent`)

On by default. Includes the protections that apply everywhere (`prot.*`). 54 rules.

### Rules in detail

- `codex.state-tmp`: Codex state temp files. Half-written copies left behind when Codex saved its global state. Codex works from the real state file and writes new temp files when it needs them.
  Matches `~/.codex/..codex-global-state.json*.tmp-*`.
- `codex.runtime-install`: Interrupted Codex runtime installs. Leftover folder of a runtime download that never finished. Codex downloads the runtime again if it needs it.
  Matches `~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-runtime-install-*`.
- `antigravity.cached-data`: Antigravity old code caches. Compiled-code caches of earlier Antigravity builds. The newest folder is kept. Quit Antigravity first; it rebuilds what it needs on the next start.
  Quit first: `com.google.antigravity`.
  Matches `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/CachedData/*`.
- `antigravity.electron.cache`: Antigravity caches. Chromium caches of Antigravity: web cache, compiled code and GPU shader caches. Quit Antigravity first; it recreates them on the next start, which can be slightly slower once.
  Quit first: `com.google.antigravity`.
  Matches `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Cache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Code Cache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/GPUCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/DawnCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/DawnWebGPUCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/DawnGraphiteCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/GraphiteDawnCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/ShaderCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/GPUPersistentCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Partitions/*/Cache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Partitions/*/Code Cache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Partitions/*/GPUCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Partitions/*/DawnCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Partitions/*/DawnWebGPUCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Partitions/*/DawnGraphiteCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Partitions/*/GraphiteDawnCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Partitions/*/ShaderCache/**`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/Partitions/*/GPUPersistentCache/**`.
- `antigravity.extensions`: Antigravity obsolete extensions. Extension folders that Antigravity marked obsolete after an update. They are no longer loaded, and Antigravity would remove them itself on a restart. Quit Antigravity first.
  Quit first: `com.google.antigravity`.

- `claude.file-history`: Claude Code file history. Backups of files Claude Code edited, used to rewind changes. Archiving keeps a restorable copy; deleting means those edits can no longer be rewound.
  Matches `~/.claude/file-history/**`.
- `claude.plugin-cache`: Claude Code plugin cache. Downloaded copies of plugin versions. Versions that Claude Code lists as installed are kept; the others are fetched again if you install them.

- `claude.projects`: Claude Code sessions ({path}). Conversation transcripts, sub-agent runs and tool outputs of a project. Archiving keeps a compressed copy you can restore; deleting removes the ability to resume or search those conversations.
  Only one group per first 4 path segments.
  Matches `~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl`, `~/.claude/projects/*/*/subagents/**`, `~/.claude/projects/*/*/tool-results/**`.
- `claude.vm-images`: Claude Desktop VM images. Disk images of the Claude Desktop sandbox VM. Quit the app first. Archiving keeps a compressed copy; deleting makes the app download and set up the VM again, which takes a while.
  Quit first: `com.anthropic.claudefordesktop`.
  Only names `rootfs.img`, `vmlinuz`, `initrd*`.
  Matches `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/vm_bundles/**`.
- `codex.archived-sessions`: Archived Codex sessions. Rollout files of conversations you archived in Codex. Archiving here keeps a compressed, restorable copy; deleting removes the conversation for good.
  Matches `~/.codex/archived_sessions/*.jsonl`.
- `codex.runtimes`: Codex runtimes. Language runtimes and tools Codex downloads to run code. Removing one makes Codex download it again, at about the same size, the next time it needs it.
  Matches `~/.cache/codex-runtimes/*`.
- `codex.sessions`: Codex sessions ({path}). Rollout files of past Codex conversations. Archiving keeps a compressed copy you can restore; deleting makes the conversation unrecoverable.
  Only names `*.jsonl`; one group per first 5 path segments.
  Matches `~/.codex/sessions/**`.
- `ollama.models`: Ollama models. Downloaded language models. Disk Steward only reports the size; remove models with the command shown. Each model is downloaded again when you pull it.
  Matches `~/.ollama/models`.
  Hint shown to the user: `ollama list  # then: ollama rm <model>`
- `prot.credentials`: Credentials and keys. Sign-in tokens, private keys and certificates. Never offered for cleanup: removing one signs you out or locks you out of a service, and nothing rebuilds it.
  Only names `auth.json`, `.credentials.json`, `credentials*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.p12`, `id_rsa*`, `id_ed25519*`, `id_ecdsa*`, `*.keychain*`, `.netrc`, `*token*.json`, `.env`, `.env.*`, `.git-credentials`, `.npmrc`, `.pypirc`, `.pgpass`, `*creds*`, `*secret*`, `*-key`, `.*-key`, `*.pfx`, `*.jks`, `*.kdbx`.
  Matches `~/**`, `$TMPDIR/**`, `$CACHEDIR/**`.
- `prot.databases`: Databases. SQLite, LevelDB and similar database files. Removing one loses the history, settings or index inside it and can corrupt an app that has it open.
  Only names `*.sqlite`, `*.sqlite3`, `*.sqlite-wal`, `*.sqlite-shm`, `*.sqlite-journal`, `*.db`, `*.db-wal`, `*.db-shm`, `*.db-journal`, `*.realm`, `*.ldb`, `MANIFEST-*`, `CURRENT`, `LOCK`, `LOG`, `LOG.old`, `*.vscdb`, `*.duckdb`, `*.mdb`, `Cookies`, `Login Data`, `History`, `Web Data`, `Favicons`, `Top Sites`.
  Matches `~/**`, `$TMPDIR/**`, `$CACHEDIR/**`.
- `prot.git`: Git repositories. A .git folder holds the full history of a project. Removing it deletes that history and nothing rebuilds it.
  Matches `~/**/.git`.
- `prot.git-tree`: Git work trees. Every file of a project that has a .git folder or file next to it, whatever the file is called. Never offered for cleanup: it may be uncommitted work that nothing else holds.

- `vscode.logs`: VS Code logs. Log files of past VS Code sessions. They only matter for troubleshooting; new ones are written as you use it.

- `vscode.vsix`: VS Code extension download cache. Cached extension packages. Quit VS Code first; it downloads them again when you install or update an extension.

- `app.electron.cache`: Electron app caches ({path}). Chromium caches of an Electron app: web cache, compiled code and GPU shader caches. Quit the app first; it recreates them on the next start, which can be slightly slower once.

Quit Chrome Beta first; pages load slower until the cache fills again. A folder counts as one item, as old as its newest file, so a browser in daily use is offered only when the age filter is low.

  Matches `~/Library/Caches/Google/Chrome Beta/*/Cache`, `~/Library/Caches/Google/Chrome Beta/*/Code Cache`.
- `app.chrome-cache`: Google Chrome cache. One profile's cache folders (Cache and Code Cache) in Google Chrome, each removed whole. Quit Chrome first; pages load slower until the cache fills again. A folder counts as one item, as old as its newest file, so a browser in daily use is offered only when the age filter is low.

A folder counts as one item, as old as its newest file, so a browser in daily use is offered only when the age filter is low.
  Quit first: `org.chromium.Chromium`.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/Chromium/*/Cache`, `~/Library/Caches/Chromium/*/Code Cache`.
- `app.edge-cache`: Microsoft Edge cache. One profile's cache folders (Cache and Code Cache) in Microsoft Edge, each removed whole. Quit Edge first; pages load slower until the cache fills again. A folder counts as one item, as old as its newest file, so a browser in daily use is offered only when the age filter is low.
  Quit first: `com.microsoft.edgemac`.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/Microsoft Edge/*/Cache`, `~/Library/Caches/Microsoft Edge/*/Code Cache`.
- `app.headless-chrome`: Headless Chrome leftovers. Scratch folders (scoped_dir*) that headless Chrome runs left behind, as used by browser-automation tools and AI agents. Each run makes new ones. Nothing younger than a day is offered, so a run that is still going keeps its folder.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/Google/Chrome-headless/scoped_dir*`.
- `app.vivaldi-cache`: Vivaldi cache. One profile's cache folders (Cache and Code Cache) in Vivaldi, each removed whole. Quit Vivaldi first; pages load slower until the cache fills again. A folder counts as one item, as old as its newest file, so a browser in daily use is offered only when the age filter is low.
  Quit first: `com.vivaldi.Vivaldi`.

- `app.sparkle`: Update leftovers, Sparkle ({path}). Update files that the Sparkle updater downloaded and left behind. The app downloads an update again if one is available. Nothing younger than a day is offered.
  Only one group per first 4 path segments.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/*/org.sparkle-project.Sparkle/**`.
- `app.shipit`: Update leftovers, ShipIt ({path}). Downloaded update files of Electron apps that use the ShipIt updater. The app downloads an update again if one is available. Nothing younger than a day is offered.
  Only one group per first 4 path segments.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/*.ShipIt/**`.
- `app.updater-cache`: Update leftovers ({path}). Pending updates, update.zip and block maps that an app's auto-updater kept. The updater downloads an update again if one is available. Nothing younger than a day is offered.
  Only one group per first 4 path segments.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/*-updater/**`.
- `app.logs`: App logs and crash reports ({path}). Log files and crash or diagnostic reports of apps. They only matter for troubleshooting; apps write new ones. Nothing younger than a day is offered.
  Only names `*.log`, `*.log.*`, `*.txt`, `*.json`, `*.jsonl`, `*.gz`, `*.ips`, `*.crash`, `*.diag`, `*.spin`, `*.hang`; one group per first 4 path segments.
  Matches `~/Library/Logs/**`.
- `app.tmp`: Temporary files. Files that apps left in your temporary folder. Nothing younger than 3 days is offered, so files an app is still using stay.
  Matches `$TMPDIR/*`.
- `app.tmp-dir`: Temporary folders. Folders that apps left in your temporary folder. Nothing younger than 3 days is offered, so folders an app is still using stay. A folder with databases or credentials in it stays protected.
  Matches `$TMPDIR/*`.
- `app.user-cache-dir`: Per-user system cache folders. Folders that apps keep in the per-user cache location of macOS. Apps rebuild them as needed. Nothing younger than 3 days is offered, and a folder with databases or credentials in it stays protected.
  Matches `$CACHEDIR/*`.
- `app.caches`: App caches ({path}). Cache folders apps keep in ~/Library/Caches. Apps rebuild them as needed, so the next use can be slower once. Cache.db databases and the files beside them stay protected. Nothing younger than a day is offered.
  Only one group per first 4 path segments.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/*/**`.
- `app.leftovers`: Data of apps that are no longer installed. Application Support folders named after an app that is not installed any more. Check before you remove one: it may hold documents or settings you want back if you reinstall the app. Only folders untouched for 90 days are offered, and moving to Trash is the default.
  Matches `~/Library/Application Support/*`.
- `app.spotify-cache`: Spotify cache. Spotify's cache folder. It may hold songs you downloaded for offline play, and you would have to download them again. Quit Spotify first.
  Quit first: `com.spotify.client`.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/com.spotify.client/**`.
- `app.steward-data`: Disk Steward's own data. Disk Steward's database and archives. Restore or remove archives on the Archives page; the database is rebuilt by the next scan.
  Matches `~/Library/Application Support/Disk Steward`.

| Rule | Tier | Kind | Unit | Actions | Floor | Filter | Age basis | Priority | Detector |

| `user.large` | review | large-file | file | trash, delete | - | - | last used | 120 | - |
| `user.idle` | review | idle-file | file | trash, delete | - | 180 | last used | 110 | - |

Scan roots: `~/Desktop`, `~/Documents`, `~/Downloads`, `~/Movies`.

### Rules in detail

- `user.project-deps`: Project dependencies ({path}). node_modules, virtualenv and Cargo target folders next to a project. They are offered only when nothing in the project has changed for the idle period; the folders of an active project stay protected. npm install, pip install or cargo build recreates them.
  Only one group per first 2 path segments.
  Matches `~/Downloads/**/node_modules`, `~/Downloads/**/.venv`, `~/Downloads/**/venv`, `~/Downloads/**/target`, `~/Desktop/**/node_modules`, `~/Desktop/**/.venv`, `~/Desktop/**/venv`, `~/Desktop/**/target`, `~/Documents/**/node_modules`, `~/Documents/**/.venv`, `~/Documents/**/venv`, `~/Documents/**/target`, `~/Movies/**/node_modules`, `~/Movies/**/.venv`, `~/Movies/**/venv`, `~/Movies/**/target`.
- `user.installers`: Installers in Downloads ({path}). Disk images and installer packages (.dmg, .pkg, .mpkg, .iso, .xip). Once the software is installed they are not needed, and you can download them again. Moving to Trash is the default.
  Only names `*.dmg`, `*.pkg`, `*.mpkg`, `*.iso`, `*.xip`; one group per first 2 path segments.
  Matches `~/Downloads/**`.
- `user.large`: Large files ({path}). Files above the size limit. Only you know whether you still need them, so they are listed by size and last use. Moving to Trash is the default.
  Only size at least 524288000 bytes; one group per first 2 path segments.
  Matches `~/Downloads/**`, `~/Desktop/**`, `~/Documents/**`, `~/Movies/**`.
- `user.idle`: Idle files ({path}). Big files you have not opened or changed for a long time. Deleting is permanent; moving to Trash, the default, is not.
  Only size at least 52428800 bytes; one group per first 2 path segments.
  Matches `~/Downloads/**`, `~/Desktop/**`, `~/Documents/**`, `~/Movies/**`.
- `user.download-apps`: Apps in Downloads ({path}). Applications you downloaded and never moved to Applications. Make sure you do not run one from here, because it is gone once removed. Moving to Trash is the default.
  Only one group per first 2 path segments.
  Matches `~/Downloads/**/*.app`.
- `user.packages`: Libraries, archives and apps kept in your folders. Photos, Music, Final Cut, Logic and similar libraries, Xcode archives, and apps outside Downloads. Each looks like a folder but is one document or one app. Never offered for cleanup; manage them in their own app.
  Matches `~/Downloads/**/*.photoslibrary`, `~/Downloads/**/*.musiclibrary`, `~/Downloads/**/*.fcpbundle`, `~/Downloads/**/*.logicx`, `~/Downloads/**/*.band`, `~/Downloads/**/*.imovielibrary`, `~/Downloads/**/*.tvlibrary`, `~/Downloads/**/*.xcarchive`, `~/Desktop/**/*.photoslibrary`, `~/Desktop/**/*.musiclibrary`, `~/Desktop/**/*.fcpbundle`, `~/Desktop/**/*.logicx`, `~/Desktop/**/*.band`, `~/Desktop/**/*.imovielibrary`, `~/Desktop/**/*.tvlibrary`, `~/Desktop/**/*.xcarchive`, `~/Documents/**/*.photoslibrary`, `~/Documents/**/*.musiclibrary`, `~/Documents/**/*.fcpbundle`, `~/Documents/**/*.logicx`, `~/Documents/**/*.band`, `~/Documents/**/*.imovielibrary`, `~/Documents/**/*.tvlibrary`, `~/Documents/**/*.xcarchive`, `~/Movies/**/*.photoslibrary`, `~/Movies/**/*.musiclibrary`, `~/Movies/**/*.fcpbundle`, `~/Movies/**/*.logicx`, `~/Movies/**/*.band`, `~/Movies/**/*.imovielibrary`, `~/Movies/**/*.tvlibrary`, `~/Movies/**/*.xcarchive`, `~/Desktop/**/*.app`, `~/Documents/**/*.app`, `~/Movies/**/*.app`.
- `user.other`: Other files in {path}. Everything in your folders that no rule offers. Listed so the space they use stays visible, and never offered for cleanup.
  Only one group per first 3 path segments.
  Matches `~/Downloads/**`, `~/Desktop/**`, `~/Documents/**`, `~/Movies/**`.

Scan roots: `~/.cache/pip`, `~/.cache/puppeteer`, `~/.cache/uv`, `~/.cargo/registry`, `~/.colima`, `~/.gradle/caches`, `~/.m2/repository`, `~/.npm`, `~/.pnpm-store`, `~/Library/Developer`, `~/Library/pnpm`, `~/go/pkg/mod`.

### Rules in detail

- `dev.cargo`: Cargo registry. Crate archives and sources Cargo downloaded. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. Cargo downloads crates again when a build needs them.
  Matches `~/.cargo/registry/*`.
  Hint shown to the user: `cargo cache --autoclean  # needs cargo-cache`
- `dev.colima`: Colima virtual machine. The Colima VM, including its disk image with your containers, images and volumes. Disk Steward only reports the size; the command shown removes caches only. Deleting the VM loses local containers and volumes.
  Matches `~/.colima/*`.
  Hint shown to the user: `colima prune`
- `dev.coresimulator`: iOS Simulator devices. Data of every simulated device, including the apps installed on it. Disk Steward only reports the size; the command shown removes only devices of Xcode versions that are gone. Other devices lose their apps and test data if removed.
  Matches `~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Devices`.
  Hint shown to the user: `xcrun simctl delete unavailable  # with Xcode selected: sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app`
- `dev.go-build`: Go build cache. Compiled packages that Go reuses between builds. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. The next build is slower once.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/go-build`.
  Hint shown to the user: `go clean -cache`
- `dev.go-mod`: Go module cache. Downloaded Go modules and their sources. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. Go downloads modules again on the next build.
  Matches `~/go/pkg/mod/*`.
  Hint shown to the user: `go clean -modcache`
- `dev.gradle`: Gradle caches. Downloaded dependencies and build caches of Gradle. Disk Steward only reports the size. Gradle downloads or rebuilds them on the next build.
  Matches `~/.gradle/caches/*`.
- `dev.homebrew`: Homebrew downloads. Bottles and source archives Homebrew downloaded. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. Homebrew downloads a package again when you reinstall it.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/Homebrew`.
  Hint shown to the user: `brew cleanup --prune=all`
- `dev.maven`: Maven local repository. Artifacts Maven downloaded, and artifacts you put there with mvn install. The ones you built yourself cannot be downloaded again. Disk Steward only reports the size.
  Matches `~/.m2/repository/*`.
- `dev.node-gyp`: node-gyp headers. Node.js headers node-gyp downloads to compile native add-ons. Disk Steward only reports the size. node-gyp downloads them again when needed.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/node-gyp`.
- `dev.npm`: npm package cache. Packages npm downloaded. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. npm downloads them again on the next install.
  Matches `~/.npm/_cacache`.
  Hint shown to the user: `npm cache clean --force`
- `dev.npx`: npx cache. Packages npx downloaded to run commands. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. npx downloads a package again when you run it.
  Matches `~/.npm/_npx`.
  Hint shown to the user: `rm -rf ~/.npm/_npx  # npx re-downloads on demand`
- `dev.pip`: pip cache. Wheels and source archives pip downloaded. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. pip downloads them again on the next install.
  Matches `~/.cache/pip/*`, `~/Library/Caches/pip`.
  Hint shown to the user: `pip cache purge`
- `dev.playwright`: Playwright browsers. Browser builds Playwright downloaded. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. Playwright downloads them again when a test run needs them.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright`.
  Hint shown to the user: `npx playwright uninstall --all`
- `dev.pnpm`: pnpm store. The package store pnpm shares between projects. Disk Steward only reports the size; the command shown removes only packages no project links to.
  Matches `~/Library/pnpm/store`, `~/.pnpm-store/*`, `~/Library/Caches/pnpm`.
  Hint shown to the user: `pnpm store prune`
- `dev.puccinialin`: puccinialin Rust toolchain. Rust toolchain files that Python build tools download on demand to compile Rust extensions. Disk Steward only reports the size. They are downloaded again when a build needs them.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/puccinialin`.
- `dev.puppeteer`: Puppeteer browsers. Browser builds Puppeteer downloaded. Disk Steward only reports the size. Puppeteer downloads them again when a script needs them.
  Matches `~/.cache/puppeteer/*`.
- `dev.uv`: uv cache. Wheels and source archives that uv shares between projects. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. uv downloads or builds them again when a project needs them.
  Matches `~/.cache/uv/*`.
  Hint shown to the user: `uv cache prune`
- `dev.xcode-derived-data`: Xcode DerivedData. Build products and indexes of your Xcode projects. Disk Steward only reports the size. Xcode rebuilds them, and the next build is slower. Quit Xcode before removing them.
  Matches `~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData`.
- `dev.xcode-device-support`: Xcode iOS DeviceSupport. Debug symbols Xcode copied from the iPhones and iPads you connected. Disk Steward only reports the size. Xcode copies them again the next time you connect that device version.
  Matches `~/Library/Developer/Xcode/iOS DeviceSupport`.
- `dev.yarn`: Yarn cache. Packages Yarn downloaded. Disk Steward only reports the size; run the command shown. Yarn downloads them again on the next install.
  Matches `~/Library/Caches/Yarn`.
  Hint shown to the user: `yarn cache clean`

## Never opened

A scan never lists, stats or opens these locations. They are protected by macOS or private by nature, so touching them would raise a permission prompt or read personal content. They are counted as skipped for privacy.
